metadata.case_name: NG SIK KAI v. LUI WING LOK T/A WING WAH OIL SHIP CO.

plaintiff.occupation_before: deckhand on the defendant’s fuel barge (Yue Tai)
plaintiff.occupation_after: service attendant at Tuen Mun Hospital

source: The neurological experts agreed that he had suffered a mild head injury.

injuries.description: fracture of the right temporal bone and right lateral wall of the sphenoid sinus
injuries.body_part: right temporal bone and right lateral wall of the sphenoid sinus
source: CT performed on 28 October 2013 showed fracture of the right temporal bone and right lateral wall of the sphenoid sinus.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of sphenoid bone of skull

source: He later developed right facial nerve palsy and was transferred to the ENT department.
According to the various joint expert reports, the plaintiff still has mild right facial nerve palsy (with paresis and involuntary twitching of right facial muscles)...
According to the single expert ophthalmologist, his mild facial nerve palsy causes incomplete right eye closure and exposure keraopathy (treated with eye lubricants).

injuries.description: right and left hearing impairment (binaural hearing impairment of 2.8%) / right-sided hearing loss with intermittent tinnitus
source: The ENT experts agreed that the accident caused his right and left hearing impairment (binaural hearing impairment of 2.8%), mild tinnitus, dizziness and mild facial nerve impairment.
According to the various joint expert reports, the plaintiff still has ... right-sided hearing loss with intermittent tinnitus ...
injuries.icd_description: Injury of middle or inner ear

injuries.description: 2cm laceration near the right ear and scalp haematoma at the back of the head
source: The plaintiff was taken to Queen Mary Hospital A&E with a 2cm laceration over near the right ear and a scalp haematoma at the back of the head, with tenderness on left shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

source: The plaintiff was taken to Queen Mary Hospital A&E with a 2cm laceration over near the right ear and a scalp haematoma at the back of the head, with tenderness on left shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the shoulder or upper arm, unspecified

manifestations.description: mild facial nerve impairment with paresis and involuntary twitching of right facial muscles
post-concussional syndrome (intermittent headaches, dizziness, subjective impairment of memory, irritability and insomnia)
dryness and irritation of the right eye

source: He was treated with suturing of the laceration.

treatments_received.treatment: artificial tears and eye padding for incomplete right eye closure
source: He was treated with artificial tears and eye padding.
CT scan showed no intracranial lesion.

losses.description: Right and left hearing impairment (binaural hearing impairment of 2.8%) with intermittent tinnitus
